What the sample logs show for the Fault Decoder checked against Decoder v18
How this tab works

WinCC keeps only the last 1,000 alarms. For each alarm, the days where WinCC and the DIAGNOSE log overlap are used to find the log line that reliably appears with it, and how many seconds before or after. That line is then searched for across every log file, which rebuilds the alarm's history back to the first log day. The grade shows how well the fingerprint matched the real WinCC alarms on the overlap days.

Prepmaster Log Overview v52 · built from Prepmaster\Sample LOG merged with the 19 Oct 2026 backup (DIAGNOSE logs 16 Sep – 19 Oct 15:16 plus 31 Aug; WinCC LongTerm archive merged; HitList and MessagesList from 19 Oct) · Shift days run 06:00–06:00 (day 06–18, night 18–06) · An incident groups repeats of the same fault less than 2 minutes apart · “Seen together” counts other faults within ±2 minutes of each incident; ×lift compares that with chance · Coverage is tested against the rules inside Prepmaster Fault Decoder v18.
